prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Text prompt describing the image to generate or the edits to apply. Include any constraints, styles, or details the model should follow.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model name (dropdown, same as the official node). Add models by editing MODEL_CHOICES in nodes.py.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: When fixed, the model makes a best effort to reproduce the same result, but deterministic output isn't guaranteed. Changing model or parameters still causes variation.

control_after_generate.name: Control After Generate
control_after_generate.tooltip: How the seed changes after each run: randomize / increment / decrement / fixed.

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.tooltip: If set to 'auto', matches your input image's aspect ratio; if no image is provided, a 16:9 image is usually generated.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.tooltip: Target output resolution 1K/2K/4K, converted to concrete pixels by keeping the area constant (1K≈1024², 2K≈2048², 4K≈4096²).

response_modalities.name: Response Modalities
response_modalities.tooltip: IMAGE for image-only output, IMAGE+TEXT to also return the model's text reply (applies to the chat path).

system_prompt.name: System Prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Foundational instructions that dictate the AI's behavior. Sent as a system message.

n.name: Batch Size
n.tooltip: How many images to request per run. The chat path usually returns just one.

official_api_key.name: Official Key
official_api_key.tooltip: API Key from platform.comfy.org — connect it from the Config Hub node, no need to type it here.

relay_api_key.name: Relay Key
relay_api_key.tooltip: Relay gateway token sk-xxx — connect it from the Config Hub node, no need to type it here.

relay_base_url.name: Relay Base URL
relay_base_url.tooltip: Relay gateway base URL (must include /v1) — connect it from the Config Hub node, no need to type it here.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Reference image(s). Pass a batch to use multiple images (edit / fusion).

mask.name: Mask
mask.tooltip: Inpaint mask; the white area gets replaced.

mode.name: Channel Mode
mode.tooltip: Auto: relay key routes to the relay gateway, official key routes to comfy.org. Can also be forced.

official_api_key.name: Official Key
official_api_key.tooltip: API Key from platform.comfy.org — used when going through the official channel.

relay_api_key.name: Relay Key
relay_api_key.tooltip: Relay gateway token sk-xxx (e.g. xianai.cc) — used when going through the relay.

relay_base_url.name: Relay Base URL
relay_base_url.tooltip: Relay gateway base URL, must include /v1.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model name (dropdown, shares the same list as the image node).
